panels.title: UE identity: core (IMSI, IP) to gNB (NGAP, CU-CP, CU-UP, DU, C-RNTI)
panels.description: One row per attached UE. IMSI and IP come from the core (AMF / SMF), the rest from the gNB's own UE contexts (ue_contexts and ngap codelets at attach); the two are joined on the NGAP UE IDs. Published as ue_ids by the dashboard xApp, which must be loaded before the UEs attach (setup_zmq_chan_demo.sh --telemetry). UE = the IMSI's subscriber number.

targets.expr: max by (n, imsi, ip, amf_ue_ngap_id, ran_ue_ngap_id, cucp, cuup, du, pci, rnti) (last_over_time(ue_ids[10s]))

panels.title: DL CQI
panels.description: The UE's reported wideband CQI, as the scheduler used it for each new DL transmission (DL HARQ stats). Per-UE average of each ~1 s report; min and max are in the table. Written by the dashboard xApp (jrtc_apps/dashboard), so empty unless it is loaded.

targets.expr: (label_replace(mac_dl_cqi_avg, "du", "$1", "ue", "(.*)") * on(du) group_left(n) max by (du, n) (last_over_time(ue_ids[10s]))) or on(ue) label_replace(mac_dl_cqi_avg, "n", "du$1", "ue", "(.*)")
(label_replace(mac_dl_cqi_min, "du", "$1", "ue", "(.*)") * on(du) group_left(n) max by (du, n) (last_over_time(ue_ids[10s]))) or on(ue) label_replace(mac_dl_cqi_min, "n", "du$1", "ue", "(.*)")
(label_replace(mac_dl_cqi_max, "du", "$1", "ue", "(.*)") * on(du) group_left(n) max by (du, n) (last_over_time(ue_ids[10s]))) or on(ue) label_replace(mac_dl_cqi_max, "n", "du$1", "ue", "(.*)")

panels.title: UL SNR
panels.description: PUSCH SINR the gNB measures on each UL transmission, in whole dB. Per-UE average of each ~1 s report; min and max are in the table. Written by the dashboard xApp (jrtc_apps/dashboard), so empty unless it is loaded.

targets.expr: (label_replace(mac_ul_snr_avg_db, "du", "$1", "ue", "(.*)") * on(du) group_left(n) max by (du, n) (last_over_time(ue_ids[10s]))) or on(ue) label_replace(mac_ul_snr_avg_db, "n", "du$1", "ue", "(.*)")
(label_replace(mac_ul_snr_min_db, "du", "$1", "ue", "(.*)") * on(du) group_left(n) max by (du, n) (last_over_time(ue_ids[10s]))) or on(ue) label_replace(mac_ul_snr_min_db, "n", "du$1", "ue", "(.*)")
(label_replace(mac_ul_snr_max_db, "du", "$1", "ue", "(.*)") * on(du) group_left(n) max by (du, n) (last_over_time(ue_ids[10s]))) or on(ue) label_replace(mac_ul_snr_max_db, "n", "du$1", "ue", "(.*)")

panels.title: DL throughput (MAC)
panels.description: DL bit rate the MAC scheduler delivers to each UE: the bytes of new transport blocks, less those dropped after the last HARQ retransmission, per ~1 s DL HARQ report. Total is the sum over the UEs. Written by the dashboard xApp (jrtc_apps/dashboard), so empty unless it is loaded.

targets.expr: (label_replace(mac_dl_tput_mbps, "du", "$1", "ue", "(.*)") * on(du) group_left(n) max by (du, n) (last_over_time(ue_ids[10s]))) or on(ue) label_replace(mac_dl_tput_mbps, "n", "du$1", "ue", "(.*)")
sum(mac_dl_tput_mbps)

panels.title: GTP Arrival Rate
panels.description: DL user-plane arrival into the gNB, measured per packet at PDCP ingress (first per-packet DL hook available; no GTP-U hook exists in this srsRAN build). Correlates with TCP throughput.

targets.expr: (label_replace(upt_gtp_arrival_mbps{bearer=~"$bearer"}, "cuup", "$1", "ue", "(.*)") * on(cuup) group_left(n) max by (cuup, n) (last_over_time(ue_ids[10s]))) or on(ue) label_replace(upt_gtp_arrival_mbps{bearer=~"$bearer"}, "n", "cu$1", "ue", "(.*)")

panels.title: RLC Queuing Latency
panels.description: Per-SDU time from arrival at RLC to start of transmission (srsRAN latency_ns), averaged per ~134 ms bucket. Dashed = per-bucket max. Correlates with TCP RTT.

targets.expr: (label_replace(upt_rlc_queue_latency_ms{bearer=~"$bearer"}, "du", "$1", "ue", "(.*)") * on(du) group_left(n) max by (du, n) (last_over_time(ue_ids[10s]))) or on(ue) label_replace(upt_rlc_queue_latency_ms{bearer=~"$bearer"}, "n", "du$1", "ue", "(.*)")

(label_replace(upt_rlc_pkt_lat_p95_ms, "du", "$1", "ue", "(.*)") * on(du) group_left(n) max by (du, n) (last_over_time(ue_ids[10s]))) or on(ue) label_replace(upt_rlc_pkt_lat_p95_ms, "n", "du$1", "ue", "(.*)")

(label_replace(upt_rlc_pkt_lat_p99_ms, "du", "$1", "ue", "(.*)") * on(du) group_left(n) max by (du, n) (last_over_time(ue_ids[10s]))) or on(ue) label_replace(upt_rlc_pkt_lat_p99_ms, "n", "du$1", "ue", "(.*)")

panels.title: RLC Buffer Occupancy
panels.description: Live RLC SDU-queue depth sampled on every enqueue/dequeue (srsRAN sdu_queue_info), reported per ~134 ms bucket. Correlates with TCP bytes-in-flight / cwnd.

targets.expr: (label_replace(upt_rlc_buffer_bytes_avg{bearer=~"$bearer"}, "du", "$1", "ue", "(.*)") * on(du) group_left(n) max by (du, n) (last_over_time(ue_ids[10s]))) or on(ue) label_replace(upt_rlc_buffer_bytes_avg{bearer=~"$bearer"}, "n", "du$1", "ue", "(.*)")

(label_replace(upt_rlc_buffer_bytes_max{bearer=~"$bearer"}, "du", "$1", "ue", "(.*)") * on(du) group_left(n) max by (du, n) (last_over_time(ue_ids[10s]))) or on(ue) label_replace(upt_rlc_buffer_bytes_max{bearer=~"$bearer"}, "n", "du$1", "ue", "(.*)")
upt_ctrl_byte_limit

panels.title: TCP / application metrics (tcpdump on UPF ogstun)
TCP Throughput
panels.description: DL goodput per UE, measured as bytes newly ACKed per bucket on the server->UE flow. Correlates with GTP Arrival Rate above (arrival is higher: it counts every byte pushed into PDCP including TCP retransmissions, throughput counts only ACKed bytes).

targets.expr: (tcp_throughput_mbps * on(ip) group_left(n) max by (ip, n) (last_over_time(ue_ids[10s]))) or on(ip) label_replace(tcp_throughput_mbps, "n", "$1", "ip", "(.*)")

panels.title: TCP RTT
panels.description: Round-trip time from data segment to covering ACK, on the same bucket grid as the RAN panels. Should track RLC Queuing Latency directly above - that queue is the dominant term.

targets.expr: (tcp_rtt_ms * on(ip) group_left(n) max by (ip, n) (last_over_time(ue_ids[10s]))) or on(ip) label_replace(tcp_rtt_ms, "n", "$1", "ip", "(.*)")
(tcp_rtt_max_ms * on(ip) group_left(n) max by (ip, n) (last_over_time(ue_ids[10s]))) or on(ip) label_replace(tcp_rtt_max_ms, "n", "$1", "ip", "(.*)")

panels.title: TCP Bytes in Flight
panels.description: highest_seq_sent - highest_ack_received, i.e. unacknowledged data (a proxy for cwnd). Correlates with RLC Buffer Occupancy above; it runs somewhat higher because in-flight also covers bytes queued in PDCP/GTP-U and on the wire, not just the RLC SDU queue.

targets.expr: (tcp_bytes_in_flight * on(ip) group_left(n) max by (ip, n) (last_over_time(ue_ids[10s]))) or on(ip) label_replace(tcp_bytes_in_flight, "n", "$1", "ip", "(.*)")
(tcp_bytes_in_flight_max * on(ip) group_left(n) max by (ip, n) (last_over_time(ue_ids[10s]))) or on(ip) label_replace(tcp_bytes_in_flight_max, "n", "$1", "ip", "(.*)")
last_over_time(bufsize_char_sdu_set{setpoint=~".+SDU",ue="0"}[6h])
last_over_time(bufsize_char_lat_mean_ms{setpoint=~".+SDU",ue="0"}[6h])
last_over_time(bufsize_char_lat_p95_ms{setpoint=~".+SDU",ue="0"}[6h])
last_over_time(bufsize_char_tput_mbps{setpoint=~".+SDU",ue="0"}[6h])
last_over_time(bufsize_char_tput_p95_mbps{setpoint=~".+SDU",ue="0"}[6h])
